news.headline: Tulane practices on grass to get ready for Duke
news.summary: The Green Wave held their last tune-up practice Friday at the Saints facility so they could work on a real grass field. Duke's stadium has grass, and Tulane opens there on September 5.

news.headline: Zeon Chriss-Gremillion will start at quarterback
news.summary: Coach Will Hall picked Chriss-Gremillion to start Tulane's opener at Duke on September 5. He has started 13 college games, first at Louisiana and then at Houston.

news.headline: Two quarterbacks lead the way in last scrimmage
news.summary: Kadin Semonza and Zeon Chriss-Gremillion took most of the first-team snaps in Tulane's final scrimmage on Saturday at Yulman Stadium. Coach Will Hall said he will name his starting quarterback on Monday.

news.headline: Sumrall says Florida will not add former pro players
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said Friday that his roster is full and he is not signing anyone who has played pro football. He said that once a player goes pro, that ship has sailed.

news.headline: Aaron Philo will start at quarterback for Florida
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall named Philo his starting quarterback on Monday. Philo transferred in from Georgia Tech and beat out Tramell Jones Jr. for the job.

news.headline: Myles Graham makes top defender watch list
news.summary: Florida linebacker Myles Graham was named to the watch list for the Bednarik Award, given to college football's best defensive player. He led the Gators with 76 tackles last season.

news.headline: Three Texas freshmen make a national award list
news.summary: Linebacker Tyler Atkinson, receiver Jermaine Bishop Jr. and pass rusher Richard Wesley were named to the watch list for the Shaun Alexander Freshman of the Year Award. Only Alabama, Michigan and Ohio State had as many players on it.

news.headline: Arch Manning named to Manning Award watch list
news.summary: Forty quarterbacks made the preseason list for the award, which goes to the best quarterback in college football. It is named for Arch's grandfather Archie and his uncles Peyton and Eli.

news.headline: Nobody hurt in Texas scrimmage, Goosby improving
news.summary: Coach Steve Sarkisian said Texas ran 120 plays on Saturday without a new injury. Left tackle Trevor Goosby is making good progress on his bruised knee, and lineman Laurence Seymore returns to practice Monday.

news.headline: Saints let go of 10 players before Sunday's deadline
news.summary: The Saints released 10 players late Saturday, including receivers Bub Means and Ronnie Bell. The team has to be down to 53 players by 5 p.m. Sunday, so more cuts are still coming.

news.headline: Saints must cut down to 53 players by Sunday
news.summary: The Saints have to go from 90 players to 53 by Sunday. Coach Kellen Moore said a lot of hard decisions come right after Friday's win at Dallas.

news.headline: Saints beat Cowboys 27-24 on a last-minute kick
news.summary: Daniel Carlson made a 53-yard field goal with under a minute left Friday night in Arlington. All three kickers competing for the job kicked in the game, which closed out the preseason.

news.headline: IUP beats Wayne State to close the tournament
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks won 24-26, 25-22, 25-22, 25-20 on Saturday in Detroit. Sammy Stephens had a career-best 14 kills and Charlotte Potvin served five aces.

news.headline: Quincy beats IUP in four sets
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks won the first set 25-17 on Saturday morning in Detroit and then lost the next three. Delaney Concannon led IUP with 13 kills and Brooke Kessler had 12 digs.

news.headline: IUP wins a five-set thriller over Northwood
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks won 25-15, 18-25, 22-25, 25-23, 19-17 on Friday in Detroit for their first win of the season. Their 73 kills were the most the team has had under coach Avery Moore.

news.headline: Yankees beat Red Sox 9-2 in the nightcap
news.summary: New York had 13 hits Saturday night and every one of them was a single. Max Fried pitched into the fourth inning in his first game back from the injured list.

news.headline: George Lombard Jr. leaves game with a sore knee
news.summary: The rookie shortstop hurt his right knee on a swing in the second inning Saturday and came out of the game in the fourth. The Yankees said he would have the knee scanned that night.

news.headline: Red Sox shut out Yankees 6-0
news.summary: Boston pitcher Jake Bennett gave up only three hits in six innings Saturday afternoon and New York never scored. It was the first game of a doubleheader at Yankee Stadium.
